Occurrence.title: Occurrence
Occurrence.description: Represents a guest occurrence daily log entry.

id.description: The unique ID of the occurrence log.

occurrenceType.description: The type of incident (e.g., Reclamação, Feedback positivo).

sector.description: The sector associated with this incident (e.g., AeB, Estrutura, TI, Lazer).

source.description: The origin channel of the occurrence. Defaults to resort.

Report.title: Report
Report.description: A saved historical summary report of occurred incidents over a specified date range.

id.description: The unique ID of the report.

title.description: Name of the report (e.g., Relatório de Ocorrências Abril).

startDate.description: The start bounds of this report.

endDate.description: The end bounds of this report.

sectorSummaries.description: JSON string or serialized structure containing sector key, amount, and the qualitative summary text.

/occurrences/{occurrenceId}.description: Flat collection representing daily logged incidents.

/reports/{reportId}.description: Saved summary reports generated across specific ranges.
